# Query row compatibility

| Operation | Accepted input | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| WHERE, DISTINCT_SYMBOLS | Symbols | Symbols |
| EXPAND_RELATION, WALK | Symbols | Symbols with relation or traversal evidence |
| JOIN INNER | Symbols and one retained symbol operand | Named binding rows |
| JOIN SEMI, JOIN ANTI | Symbols and one retained symbol operand | Symbols; ANTI needs complete right coverage |
| PROJECT_BINDING | Binding rows and one declared binding name | Symbols |
| TRACE | Symbols | Grouped symbols with proven connections and occurrences |
| EMIT | Rows compatible with the selected output | The existing typed result projection |
